purpose.objective: Prepare academy operations orchestration with a separate Work branch, the maintained common Git harness, source-pinned academy repository inventory, an explicitly identified Hermes frontend TUI and Bot Screen, and a source-grounded user interview.
successCriteria: A separate academy Work branch starts from an observed current Education main revision without altering existing Work records.
Canonical purpose, original user direction, Spec, Plan, Task ownership, dependencies and consumed-effect fences pass the maintained common Git Work reader.
All discovered academy-related repositories have explicit source ownership, revision and local readiness observations.
The frontend Hermes TUI and Bot Screen route are observed on hermes-agent-2q3y with exact native owner and terminal identity receipts.
An interview is ready to resolve current academy priorities, frontend feedback and assessment/MCP unknowns; answers remain pending until the user provides them.
inScope: Local repository preparation and an isolated source-owned coordination Work.
Use of the existing agent-platform common Git reader without copying its implementation or modifying native hooks.
The requested frontend Hermes TUI pane and Bot Screen readiness on hermes-agent-2q3y, operated by the native runtime owner.
Source/context review and user interview preparation; additional panes only as needed.
outOfScope: Native model/configuration/trust/credential changes, deployment, production or student-data writes.
Resuming unrelated paused Harness Work or replaying historical completed/uncertain academy effects.
Automatic final exam item selection, exam generation, parent transmission, SQL or database migration.
Repository push, PR, automatic merge, semantic acceptance or implicit native hook activation.
